title: Clan gRUS
wikitext:
Norwegian clan, active from 1997 to 1998. Merged with the clan [[Softology]] at one point, but kept the name Clan gRUS also with new faces in the ranks. Mostly played on LAN-parties, not so much online. Participated at [[AskerLAN]] III, IV, V and VII, where a match against [[The Vicious Vikings]] quickly became a tradition, as the gallery below will show.
